en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,621 | Every time you start a new coding session, your AI agent forgets everything and starts from zero. Claude-Mem solves this by running a **second agent** beside it to take notes, compress activity with AI, and inject **relevant context** back into future sessions. It works seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and many other popular coding tools.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为每个AI编程助手提供跨会话的长效记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,621 | 每次开启新的编程会话时，你的AI助手总是会失忆并从零开始。Claude-Mem 通过在旁边运行一个**观察者助手**来记录工作、用AI进行压缩，并在未来会话中自动注入**相关上下文**。它能与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等众多主流编程工具完美配合。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A Controlled Simulation Framework for Robot Learning
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, an open simulation framework designed to study robot learning in a controlled environment. The system uses a robotic arm and blocks to automatically generate tasks and demonstrations, helping scientists **test how AI models learn**, generalize, and fail without needing complex real-world setups.

zh.title: ToyBlocks：一个用于机器人学习的受控模拟框架
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了 **ToyBlocks**，这是一个开源的模拟框架，旨在受控环境中研究机器人学习。该系统利用机械臂和积木自动生成任务与演示，帮助科学研究人员在无需复杂现实世界设置的情况下，**测试AI模型的学习**、泛化和失败原因。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU to cut AI inference costs
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG) partitioning, allowing users to divide a single physical GPU into independent slices. This helps companies **deploy more models** on a single instance, avoid wasting hardware resources on smaller models, and achieve **hardware-level isolation** for predictable performance and better cost efficiency.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 现已支持多实例 GPU，大幅降低 AI 推理成本
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 现在支持英伟达的多实例 GPU（MIG）切分技术，允许把一块完整的显卡拆成多个独立的小分区。这项功能让企业可以在单台设备上**部署多个模型**，告别小模型白白浪费整张显卡的尴尬，并且能做到**硬件级隔离**，让性能更稳定、成本更划算。

en.title: Capital Cools Down on World Models as Market Faces Reality
en.summary: Venture capital is pulling back from the **world model** sector, ending the earlier funding frenzy. While concept-driven startups struggle to raise money, investors are now tightening their purses and strictly backing **top-tier talents** with proven technical execution.

zh.title: 资本正在撤离“世界模型”，市场迎来现实降温
zh.summary: 曾经火热的“世界模型”赛道迎来了资本退潮，投资人不再盲目追逐概念。如今市场急剧降温，只有极少数具备**硬核技术**和明星背景的顶尖团队才能顺利拿到大钱。

en.title: Do AI startups still stand a chance in Personal Agent?
en.summary: Personal Agent brings AI entrepreneurship to a new phase where **value and competitiveness** can grow beyond base models. Although tech giants hold advantages in infrastructure and capital, startups can still find a **viable path** by focusing on deep user context and specific vertical scenarios rather than competing in raw model capability.

zh.title: 创业者做 Personal Agent，有没有一线生机？
zh.summary: Personal Agent 把 AI 创业带到了新阶段，产品的**核心价值**可以长在基础模型之外。虽然科技巨头在算力和资金上占据优势，但创业者依然可以通过深耕特定垂直场景和**用户信任关系**，在巨头的夹缝中找到属于自己的生存空间。

en.title: Wall Street suffers historic drop as AI bubble fears trigger massive market crash
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session in months, wiping out over **$2.5 trillion** in market value in just one day. This sudden crash was triggered by concerns over strict regulations, public pushback against massive **data centers**, and a reality check on whether AI investments will actually turn a profit.

zh.title: 华尔街遭遇历史性暴跌，AI泡沫破裂担忧引发市场巨震
zh.summary: 纳斯达克指数遭遇数月来最惨重的一天，单日蒸发超过**2.5万亿美元**的市值。这场突如其来的崩盘是由对严格监管的担忧、公众对庞大**数据中心**的反对，以及对AI投资能否真正盈利的现实审视所引发的。

en.title: GitHub is rebuilding its software stack to handle massive AI agent workloads, says Microsoft's Jay Parikh
en.summary: GitHub has grown to 225 million developers and processed 34.3 billion commits, forcing the platform to fundamentally **rebuild its software stack** for agent workloads. Jay Parikh, EVP of CoreAI at Microsoft, discussed Copilot Fusion's model orchestration, cross-device agent sessions, and the shift toward measuring AI spending against **actual business outcomes**. Parikh offered his personal perspective on **bypassing traditional pull requests** in certain repositories, while noting that the platform's infrastructure is adapting to automated traffic.

zh.title: 微软核心AI负责人Jay Parikh：GitHub正重构软件栈以应对海量AI Agent工作负载
zh.summary: GitHub已发展至2.25亿开发者并处理了343亿次提交，这迫使该平台从根本上**重构软件栈**以适应Agent工作负载。微软核心AI执行副总裁Jay Parikh探讨了Copilot Fusion的模型编排、跨设备Agent会话，以及将AI开销与**实际商业成果**挂钩的趋势。Parikh分享了他个人在某些仓库中**跳过传统Pull Request**的看法，并指出平台基础设施正全面适应自动化流量。

en.title: AI-generated complaints are overwhelming UK public bodies and businesses
en.summary: UK public bodies, local councils, and businesses are being **swamped by AI-generated** complaints and legal challenges, a phenomenon dubbed "AI clog." While chatbots give ordinary people a **free legal adviser** to write lengthy, formal-sounding letters, human employees must spend huge amounts of time sifting through them, drastically **increasing their workload**. Researchers and officials warn this is draining limited resources and clogging up essential public services.

zh.title: AI生成的投诉信正在压垮英国政府部门和企业
zh.summary: 英国的政府部门、地方议会和企业正被**AI生成的投诉**和法律挑战淹没，这种现象被称为“AI堵塞”。虽然聊天机器人让普通人拥有了**免费的法律顾问**来撰写长篇大论的正式信件，但人工职员却需要花费大量时间去甄别，从而**大幅增加了工作量**。研究人员和官员警告称，这正在耗尽有限的资源并拖慢公共服务。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Reveal 15 Design Patterns for AI Agents
en.summary: GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pooled their knowledge to release **15 design patterns** for building reliable AI agent systems. These patterns help developers manage tasks, **handle errors**, and coordinate multiple AI workers without losing control.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合公开AI智能体设计的15种模式
zh.summary: GitHub、谷歌和西门子三家公司联合整理并公开了构建可靠AI智能体系统的 **15种设计模式**。这些模式旨在帮助开发者更好地分配任务、**处理错误**，并让多个AI助手能够顺畅配合而不出乱子。

en.title: Silicon Valley Chinese Team Beats DeepSeek to Build Next-Gen Super-Agent
en.summary: DeepSeek recently proposed a super-agent architecture to solve human attention bottlenecks in AI tasks. Surprisingly, a Silicon Valley Chinese team named AFK AI built a similar **router and worker** architecture into their product Comma months ago, enabling long-term memory and **multi-task execution** through a single conversation window.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人把下一代Agent Harness造出来了
zh.summary: DeepSeek最近提出了超级智能体架构来解决AI任务中的人类注意力瓶颈。让人意外的是，硅谷华人团队AFK AI几个月前就在产品Comma中实现了类似的**主脑加执行者**架构，通过一个对话窗口实现了长期记忆和**多任务并行**处理。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open-source 6G and 5G developer tools, including Aerial and Sionna, have **surpassed 1 million downloads** worldwide as adoption grows. Researchers are using these platforms to develop **AI-native 6G networks**, enabling robots to react faster, improving wireless signal reception in emergencies, and cutting base station energy consumption.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具助力研究人员打造下一代 6G 网络
zh.summary: 英伟达的 Aerial 和 Sionna 等开源 6G 与 5G 开发工具在全球的下载量已经**突破 100 万次**。研究人员正在利用这些平台开发**人工智能原生 6G 网络**，从而让机器人反应更快、在紧急情况下更好地接收无线信号，并大幅降低基站的耗电量。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git Worktree CLI Built for Parallel AI Agents
en.summary: ⭐ 11,993 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool that **simplifies git worktrees** so you can easily run multiple **AI agents** at the same time without them stepping on each other's toes.

zh.title: Worktrunk：为并行 AI 代理量身定制的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,993 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，它能**简化 git 工作树**的操作，让你轻松同时运行多个 **AI 代理**，而不用担心它们互相干扰。

en.title: Midterm elections deal a blow to data centers and Elon Musk, prompting a policy shift from OpenAI
en.summary: Recent U.S. midterm elections saw voters and newly elected officials push back hard against **data centers**, creating major political headwinds for tech giants and Elon Musk. In response to mounting public anger and regulatory pressure over water and power usage, AI companies like OpenAI are suddenly dropping secrecy tactics and changing their **compute policies**.

zh.title: 美国中期选举重挫数据中心与马斯克，倒逼OpenAI调整政策
zh.summary: 美国最新中期选举结果显示，选民和新当选官员集体对**数据中心**说不，给科技巨头和埃隆·马斯克带来了不小的政治压力。面对公众对水电资源消耗的不满与监管收紧，以OpenAI为首的AI公司开始迅速改变保密做法，推出新的**计算园区政策**。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Environments
en.summary: Training AI agents often hits walls when their execution environments fail. Researchers introduced **Harness-S**, a clever method that uses specialized helper environments to rescue failed tasks and bake those lessons back into a **single policy**. Tested across multiple benchmarks, this approach significantly boosts agent performance without needing a complete overhaul of the original setup.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用“兄弟环境”来训练更聪明的AI智能体
zh.summary: 训练AI智能体时，经常会遇到执行环境报错卡壳的问题。研究人员推出了一种名为 **Harness-S** 的新方法，它通过准备一些特殊的“兄弟环境”来拯救失败的任务，并把学到的经验内化到一个 **单一策略** 中。多项测试表明，这种方法能在不改变原有基础环境的前提下，大幅提升AI的干活能力。

en.title: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight dinner
en.summary: I tested the new **AI assistant** in the NYT Cooking app, which helps users swap ingredients and adjust recipes. While it gave great practical advice for dinner, it almost messed up my cake by suggesting the wrong amount of **butter**, proving that AI is a helpful sous chef rather than a master.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪应用的AI助手，拯救了我的晚饭
zh.summary: 我测试了纽约时报烹饪应用里的全新**AI助手**，它能帮大家替换食材和调整菜谱。虽然它在做晚饭时给出了非常实用的建议，但由于提供了一个错误的**黄油**用量，差点把我的蛋糕给毁了，这说明AI只能当个好帮手，不能完全依赖。
